meta.title: DevPortfolio | Websites and custom systems for your business
meta.description: I build websites and systems that keep your business organised: stock, sales, bookings, clients and payments. Made to measure, clear pricing, clients worldwide.

hero.title: I organise your business with a website and a system built around you.
hero.subtitle: If you still run things on spreadsheets, notebooks or scattered messages, I'll build you one simple tool with everything in one place: sales, stock, bookings or clients. Plus the website that helps people find you.

highlights.progress: You see progress as we go

services.title: What I can do for you
services.subtitle: Tools that are simple to use, built for the day-to-day of your business.

fullstack.title: Websites and online shops
fullstack.description: Your own site, fast and looking great on mobile. To show what you do, receive enquiries or sell online.

management.title: Systems that organise your business
management.description: Software made to measure to handle stock, sales, bookings or clients. Everything in one place, with no more spreadsheets.

apis.title: Getting your tools to talk
apis.description: I connect the systems you already use so you never enter the same data twice: your site, your invoicing, your shop or your warehouse.

frontend.title: Pages that bring in clients
frontend.description: Pages designed so visitors get in touch or buy: a clear message, fast loading and a contact button always within reach.

industries.title: I work with your sector
industries.subtitle: Every business has its own way of working. The system adapts to yours, not the other way around.

retail.title: Shops and retail
retail.description: Keep track of stock, daily sales and invoicing without wasting time.

logistics.title: Transport and deliveries
logistics.description: Know where every shipment is, who is carrying it and what arrived on time.

health.title: Clinics and healthcare
health.description: Appointments, patient records and each professional's calendar in one place.

education.title: Schools and courses
education.description: Enrolment, payments and student progress, always up to date.

hospitality.title: Bars, restaurants and hotels
hospitality.description: Bookings, orders and consumption tracking, with no paper slips.

professional.title: Firms and services
professional.description: Your clients, ongoing work and payments, tidy and always at hand.
